d: Reminiscing on one of the most unforgettable moments of my life, when I had the honor of performing a solo sitar recital at the first-ever Diwali celebration hosted at the White House in 2022 by President Biden, First Lady Jill Biden, and Vice President Kamala Harris. It was an incredible privilege not only to be part of such a historic event but also to represent the rich heritage and cultural traditions of my Indian community on such a grand stage.
